name: Losses carried forward: oldest first, in nominal euros, crypto's expired after four years
workings: Prices are 25% above the plan's start, so losses kept in nominal euros are worth less in today's money: 2025's 1,250 are 1,000.00, 2027's 2,500 are 2,000.00
Crypto losses from 2023 could be used up to 2027 (the fourth following year, art. 68 c. 9-bis): expired, and dropped
Shares: gain 2,500.00, offset by losses carried forward oldest first: all 1,000.00 from 2025, then 1,500.00 of 2027's; nothing taxed
Crypto: gain 1,000.00 with no crypto losses to offset it (redditi diversi losses can't): 33% = 330.00
Carried out: 500.00 from 2027 (usable to 2031), in nominal euros 500.00 × 1.25 = 625
Selling shares with another 1,000.00 gain: 3,500.00 of gains against 3,000.00 of losses, 26% × 500.00 = 130.00
